title: RAW INCOMPLETE: shared wordbook indices written through an end-aware local transition table
summary: Root-proposed numerical carrier, not a new language or a native reading. A word has its ordinal in one fixed public wordbook. The ordinal selects a path through a small ordered transition table; an explicit end option makes paths of different lengths uniquely numbered. One non-endable forced transition consumes no numerical place. The parametric inverse is specified, but no actual22-row table, source wordbook, unknown-word mode or physical continuation is supplied. Retain unreviewed, not as a complete or selected writer.

ownership.origin: Root proposed the whole-word ordinal/local-following-table architecture and, after the producer identified a naive end collision, explicitly proposed the END-aware recurrence. Producer checked its mathematics and targeted predecessors. This is not an independent discovery or a source-blinded result.

design.purpose: A scribe consults an ordered shared wordbook and writes an ordinal by a reusable local number-spelling rule. The reader recovers that ordinal and looks up the exact word. Word meanings and sentence interpretation remain in the learned source language; an ordinal is not a semantic primitive or an independently deciphered value.
design.unit: One known complete source token per logical written group. A token's exact spelling, including any attached punctuation, must have one fixed wordbook entry. This card does not silently normalize a text or assume that every encountered token is known.
fixed_parameters_not_yet_instantiated: One ordered public list L of distinct nonempty complete source tokens, with edition and ordering fixed before writing. Word ordinal N is one-based in1..|L|.
Exactly22 distinct working drawings G with one public first-step order. These are artificial drawing labels, not proved native letters.
For each endable drawing s, one ordered nonempty successor list A_s of distinct drawings, with degree k_s in1..22.

One distinct pair of designated drawings Q and O. Q is non-endable and has exactly the forced successor O; O is endable. Every other drawing is endable. The letters Q/O here name roles; no complete working-label binding or row table has been chosen. Root's motivating q-to-o example is not a native meaning assignment.
design.writer_first_step: For N>=1 set j=(N-1) mod22 and n=floor((N-1)/22). Write G[j], then apply the state rule at that written drawing with remainder n. The first step is compulsory, so no source token has an empty spelling.
writer_state_rule: At an endable state s: if n=0, end the logical group with its paid visible boundary. If n>0, set t=n-1, j=t mod k_s and m=floor(t/k_s); write A_s[j] and continue at that new drawing with remainder m.
At Q: write its sole forced successor O and continue at O with the SAME remainder n, including when n=0. Q never ends a group. This edge carries no digit and is not an added zero digit.

Do not append a separate guard after completing an ordinary numeral. Endability and forced steps are part of this recurrence from the start. No alternative spelling, counter, previous-word memory or per-occurrence selection is allowed.
reader: A nonempty logical group must begin with a drawing in G. Every later drawing must be a listed successor of the previous drawing. A Q must be followed by O and cannot be final. The final drawing must be endable.

At the final endable state assign suffix remainder0. Work back through the visible path. For a normal edge out of s at zero-based branch j recover n=1+j+k_s*m, where m is the already recovered suffix remainder. For the forced Q-to-O edge recover n=m.

If the first drawing has first-step index j, recover N=1+j+22*n. Require N in1..|L| and return L[N]. A legal numeral whose ordinal exceeds the book is not an unknown word: it is outside the known-word mode.
Restore the explicitly supplied logical word boundaries. The recurrence does not invent punctuation, clause boundaries, referents, omitted words or source meanings.
design.termination_and_uniqueness: Every normal nonterminal step takes positive n to floor((n-1)/k_s)<n. The sole non-endable step goes from Q to endable O, so at most one forced edge can occur before either ending or another strict decrease. Encoding therefore terminates for every positive ordinal. At an endable state the empty suffix has remainder0, while any nonempty suffix has1+j+k_s*m>0. Distinct branches have distinct residues modulo k_s. A forced non-endable edge has exactly one visible continuation and cannot be confused with stopping. Backward recursion and the first-step residue therefore recover exactly one N; every canonical encoded path has that inverse. This is a parametric proof, not an executed decoder or a statistical result.
design.explicit_boundary_of_proof: Positive degrees and pairwise distinct row labels are required. An endable degree-zero state cannot encode arbitrary positive remainders. A reachable cycle consisting only of non-endable forced edges can fail to terminate. Neither exception belongs to the stated Q-to-O contract. Generalizing the graph requires a separate well-foundedness account.
human_cost: The complete ordered wordbook remains mandatory. Alphabetical ordering may derive ordinal assignments, but does not remove the cost of possessing, searching and correctly identifying every entry. The rule is a nomenclator-like address system, not a small learned natural vocabulary.

The local table has22 ordered rows, an ordered22-drawing initial list and explicit endability. In the worst case the21 endable rows each list22 successors, plus one forced edge:463 listed edges. Shared patterns could simplify a future table, but none is supplied here.

Writing needs the current table row, integer remainder, subtraction, division by the row degree and remainder selection. The initial word lookup is separate. Reading needs row/branch lookups and backward multiplication/addition with an accumulator; the already written path can be consulted, but this is still arithmetic work rather than ordinary reading fluency.

No previous-word cache, character counter or hidden reset is needed. Repeated known words are fully written again and may repeat any number of times. A changed wordbook edition changes word interpretations and must be shared explicitly.
still_unpaid_full_writer_parts: No actual22-row successor table or complete ordered wordbook is frozen; local glyph frequencies, lengths and useful compression therefore have not been constructed.

An unknown proper name or inflection has no ordinal. An explicit literal mode, its source alphabet, collision-free mode distinction and all literal/control signs must be supplied before claiming an open writer. Enlarging L silently is not a fallback.

Source punctuation, capitalization, paragraph boundaries and whitespace need an explicit input contract. Exact source wording is preserved only to the extent that these are actually included in tokens or paid controls.

Logical spaces have a stated role, but physical line width, overwide words, interruption of forced Q-to-O and an unambiguous paid continuation rule remain unspecified. No invisible line-boundary bit or native paragraph correspondence is assumed.

No complete sentence has been encoded. Root explicitly requested preservation of this unfinished numerical module without choosing a concrete table or source; a toy paragraph would conceal those unpaid choices.
fixed_form_obligations: The first22ordinals necessarily include21distinct one-drawing words and the two-drawing QO word, independent of the successor rows. This is an unavoidable consequence of the stated first-step/end rules, not a later chosen short-word palette.

All complete logical words end in one of the21endable drawings. This does not inherit1195's six-short-final cap. However, no actual table or source use has established all required short finals or large interior diversity.

Identical source words yield identical codes, so arbitrary adjacent whole-word triples are permitted. A fixed wordbook supplies no eviction, obligatory repeat header or stable-cache-address capacity issue.

For any complete code B whose boundary is endable, BB is not automatically legal: the edge from final(B) to first(B) and the resulting ordinal must be legal. No value is assigned to ol, olol or any other native group.

A forbidden successor pair is a formal falsifier once a table and working-sign binding are independently fixed. Lexical resemblance does not identify a row or imply that neighboring numerical addresses have related meanings.
design.frequency_invariant: For the known-word mode, one fixed injective source-word-to-whole-group map preserves the complete word-equality partition, type count, ranked word frequencies and exact adjacent repetition counts. It can change lengths and within-word glyph transitions.1202and1226therefore still exclude unchanged use on their fixed four old profiles, including their tested mixtures; no new carrier can repair those source-word frequency failures. That is not a general exclusion of all languages or of a different explicitly specified source. A literal mode, continuation or changed grouping would require its own unit/accounting contract.
design.important_nonclaim: The graph constrains which glyph transitions are possible; it does not determine their empirical frequency independently of the wordbook order and source word frequencies. q-to-o or a preferred final drawing is not automatically a complete statistical explanation. No native meaning, alphabet, morphology, near-repetition law or historical use has been established.
design.known_q_o_caution: Root explicitly reports that the retained native q-to-o transition is strong, approximately97-98percent, but not exceptionless. The exact Q-to-O law in this abstract module therefore must not be promoted to an established literal native q/o rule. A later aggregate statistical pass could conceal individually illegal complete groups. No new exception mechanism, spelling alias or error allowance is added here; the actual native binding remains open and any later candidate must retain the already known exceptions as countercases.

design.strong_counterexample_before_this_raw: A different naive scheme used ordinary bijective first-step arithmetic and appended O only to a completed terminal Q. Let Q be first-step choice r in1..22. Ordinal r would become QO after the append; ordinal r+22 would leave remainder1, consume the radix-one Q-to-O step and also become QO. This collision rejects that naive composition. The present END-aware recurrence was explicitly proposed before any table, source writing or measurement and assigns no digit to the forced edge; it is a different stated contract, not a fitted correction of a tested writer.
design.dictionary_counterexample: If a two-entry alphabetical book contains BROT and SALZ, ordinal2 means SALZ. Silently adding BUTTER between them makes the same ordinal mean BUTTER. Correct numerical decoding cannot detect that unannounced edition mismatch. The example is invented, has no native counterpart and does not constitute a selected source language.
design.smallest_decision_changing_next_step: No corpus or target test is selected. Before a whole-message hand trial, a proponent must freeze the actual finite table, known-wordbook edition, unknown-name spelling, punctuation and physical continuation. A reader then has to recover an entire message from those public rules alone, including an ordinal with several different row degrees and a real unknown name. A failed boundary/inverse rejects that complete contract; a successful readback establishes only limited teachability. Repeating the parametric arithmetic proof alone would not justify a scientific writer selection.
